Name: Mail Services Better Menu
Author: Cpdncristiano
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

Tired of searching through a huge recipient list just to find one NPC?

In heavily modded games, expansion mods and custom NPC packs can add dozens or even hundreds of new villagers. As the number of NPCs grows, finding someone in the original Mail Services Mod recipient list can become increasingly difficult.

Mail Services Better Menu was created to make this process faster and more convenient. It replaces the original recipient list with a clean grid-based menu where you can search villagers by name, apply filters, and organize the list using different sorting options.

This mod focuses exclusively on improving the main recipient selection menu. All mail functionality and gameplay rules remain handled by Mail Services Mod.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Replaces the original recipient list with a grid-based menu.[/*]
[*]Searches villagers by their displayed name.[/*]
[*]Filters villagers by their reaction to the selected gift.[/*]
[*]Filters villagers by friendship status.[/*]
[*]Sorts villagers alphabetically, by gift reaction, or by the original Mail Services order.[/*]
[*]Displays villager portraits, names, birthdays, gift reactions, and friendship hearts.[/*]
[*]Supports large collections of custom NPCs and expansion mods.[/*]
[*]Includes an optional compact layout that displays more villagers on each page.[/*]
[*]Allows the default filters, sorting method, compact layout, and friendship display to be configured.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842]Mail Services Mod[/url][/*]
[/list]
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and can be used to change the menu's default settings in-game.

This is an add-on for Mail Services Mod and does not include the original mod.


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Digus]Digus[/url], the creator of Mail Services Mod. This add-on would not exist without his original work.
